editorial:
Imagine waking up in a quiet little town where everyone knows your name, only to find out a killer is picking people off one by one. You get to follow a tough sheriff and his daughter as they try to stop the madness while a panicked mayor makes things even worse. The vibe is super tense and feels like a race against time. It is the kind of movie that makes you lock your doors and look twice at your neighbors because you never know who is actually the bad guy.

The acting is great and the plot twists really catch you off guard. While some parts of the middle feel a bit slow, the ending totally makes up for it with some wild action scenes. If you love a good mystery that keeps you guessing, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gritty details. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move so you can watch it whenever you want.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the mayor was actually helping the killer to hide a dark secret from the town's past. The sheriff catches the killer in a big showdown at the old mill. After a scary fight, the sheriff and his daughter manage to take the killer down together. The movie ends with the town finally feeling safe, though the sheriff knows some secrets will stay buried forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves murder mysteries and scary thrillers.
